item: Everything is in the wrong order
Gravity gets stronger the longer you stay
It has an unnecessary sense of urgency
It has read too many productivity books
It is convinced it is helping
It is extremely proud of one small feature
It is having a minor crisis
It is in denial about what it is
It is quietly judging your choices
It is running out of ink
It is shy and hides when you look
It is trying to look more expensive than it is
It is run by a committee that disagrees
It needs two people to use
It only works if you go slowly
It rearranges itself when you are not looking
It refuses to move on from 2007
It thinks it is a different website
It wants to be your best friend immediately
Loads like it is on dial-up
